welcomePage.title: Getting Started
welcomePage.intro: Welcome to Leafen! This page is yours to keep, change or delete.
welcomePage.slash: Type / anywhere to add headings, lists, to-dos, tables, images and more.
welcomePage.pages: Add pages from the sidebar, and put pages inside other pages to keep things organized.
welcomePage.databases: Create a database to track tasks, projects or anything else, and see it as a table, board or calendar.
welcomePage.together: Invite people to your workspace and edit pages together in real time.
welcomePage.agents: Connect Claude Code, Codex, or the Claude and ChatGPT apps so they use Leafen as your memory: the workspace name in the sidebar → {{connectAgent}}

notionImportHandoff.link: If you’d rather not paste it here, put it in Leafen instead: in Leafen’s import screen ({{url}}), put it in the “{{field}}” field and press “{{save}}”. Leafen keeps it encrypted, and I go on as soon as it is in.
notionImportHandoff.rest: Last, paste the token here in our conversation: I hand it to Leafen, which keeps it encrypted, and go on. This conversation keeps it too, so when the move is done, delete that connection in Notion or make it a new token.

passwords.title: App passwords
passwords.note: Programs outside Leafen — a file manager, a password manager’s extension — use these to reach the app at its address. They do only what you may through the app, and can’t log in to Leafen.

passwords.createdNote: Put the username and password into the program’s login.
passwords.limit: An app can have up to 20 passwords. Revoke one you don’t use.
passwords.near: You can create {{left}} more passwords for this app (up to {{limit}} per app). Revoke ones you don’t use.
passwords.full: This app has reached its password limit (up to {{limit}} per app). Revoke one you don’t use before creating another.
passwords.stored: Files you keep through this app: {{used}}
passwords.storedOf: Files you keep through this app: {{used}} of {{limit}}
